title: Sketch Hop
description: An endless doodle-style jumper drawn on graph paper. Bounce up an infinite page: green platforms hold, blue ones slide, brown ones crumble underfoot and white ones vanish after a single bounce. Springs and trampolines fling you; propeller hats, jetpacks and rockets fly you through whole screens; a shield eats one monster. Five inked monsters block the way — land on their heads or shoot ink from your nose — while UFO tractor beams and black holes hunt you between platforms. Steer by dragging or by tilting the phone. Every run submits your height to a global leaderboard.
